title: The Clockmakers’ Day Off
description: Once a year the clockmakers take the hands off the tower clock. The minute hand becomes a bench, and anyone is welcome to sit for as long as they like.
alt: A family sits on a bench made from a giant iron clock hand below a handless clocktower, with spring blossoms and snowy mountains behind them.
pairing: An imagined clockmakers’ holiday × a minute hand turned into a bench
